Package logic

Class ReportCancelRow

java.lang.Object
logic.ReportCancelRow
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ReportCancelRow extends Object implements Serializable
one row in the Cancellation Report.

represents a single cancelled or no-show order. part of a CANCEL_REPORT_DATA message; displayed with colour-coded status cells in ReportsController.

    • ReportCancelRow

      public ReportCancelRow(int id, String parkName, String visitorId, String visitDate, String visitTime, String orderType, String status, int numVisitors, String createdAt)
      Parameters:
      id - the database order ID
      parkName - the park name
      visitorId - the visitor's ID number
      visitDate - the planned visit date in yyyy-MM-dd format
      visitTime - the planned visit time in HH:mm format
      orderType - the order type in uppercase
      status - "CANCELLED" or "NO_SHOW" (uppercase)
      numVisitors - the number of visitors on the cancelled order
      createdAt - the booking creation timestamp in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm format
